QUOTE: "**Compile time.** Define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO`... **Runtime.** Define only `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, then call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`... In macro mode it is not declared and not compiled, so calling it fails to link."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer pair and says the runtime setter doesn't exist in macro mode, which makes the two mutually exclusive.
